ENV-SECTOR-ROSTER-DRIVER-CONTRACT-1.change: lua/entity-authority.lua parse_scan_request/scan_reply_problem/scan_question: phases 0..6, 16 patterns then (one space, identity) with the standing key required (a roster key: 1 to 20 digits, no leading zero) in ENTRY and RESOLVED only, FIRST/NEXT name = a roster key or empty, INSERT (only position/type/side stated, optional identity of at most 128 bytes) / REMOVE (key) / RESET (nothing) with replies placed (a key never issued before) / removed / cleared (no key, no cursor); state-by-phase and kernel joins (entry not excluded -> offer, excluded -> next, hit -> done_hit, miss -> next); key joins (a scan stands at the entry it was last served, never at an ended one; an ended entry is never served or removed again; an issued key is never reused). Roster events are counted in scan.roster apart from the scan's own questions in both windows (before.roster/after.roster, report roster_* fields), are never altered by a mode and credit no scan control; the Original profile treats any roster event as 'the module is not the original'. ENV-SECTOR-ROSTER-FP-BOUNDARY-1.change: roster.rs word_truncated/word_whole/parse_key and model_host.rs: every roster word (phase, position, type, side, cursor, standing key) is classified and truncated by integer operations on the raw word; no floating-point instruction, compare, floor or conversion touches it. Non-finite (including every signaling NaN) and magnitude over 1.0e9 words are refused by name; fractional words are not whole; the truncation is the compiler's toward-zero conversion for every in-domain word (a 200000-word sweep plus 12 edge words is compared with `as i32` and trunc()). The eager `bool.then_some(value as i32)` is gone. The kernel's scan_step keeps its own bounded guard, unchanged.
ENV-SECTOR-ROSTER-FP-BOUNDARY-1.tests: entity_roster_host.rs the_roster_arithmetic_hands_back_the_callers_whole_floating_point_state_for_fractional_and_malformed_words: for each caller rounding (Nearest, Up, Down, Zero) with the caller's exception status clear and with it raised, a placement with fractional coordinates (truncated to sector (1,1), never rounded), a served first entry and 11 malformed raw-word cases (signaling and infinite phase, signaling and infinite positions, signaling and fractional type, signaling side, signaling cursor, excluded and hit flags) all give the named refusal and leave the whole caller state (masks, rounding, raw x87 control, raw MXCSR incl. status, raised flags) equal. roster.rs: 2 unit tests (integer classification vs `as i32`; key domain).
ENV-SECTOR-ROSTER-FP-BOUNDARY-1.red: red-roster2: with the 7bec source the fractional placement changed the caller's state (mxcsr 8064 -> 8096, exception flags 0 -> 32, the inexact flag) under Nearest, raised=false.

ENV-SECTOR-ROSTER-STANDING-KEY-1.change: model_host.rs entity_scan_answer: before scan_step, ENTRY (1) and RESOLVED (3) must carry a standing key (strict roster-key domain), validated against the live roster and, when the cursor words are a sector, the sector the scan is in; BEGIN (0), END (2) and RESET carry none ('carries no standing key' / 'a boot carries no identity'). INSERT keeps its optional mobile identity, REMOVE its key (now the strict key domain). The Offer, skip, DoneHit and Next paths all see the same validated key.
ENV-SECTOR-ROSTER-STANDING-KEY-1.tests: entity_roster_host.rs the_standing_key_of_an_entry_or_a_resolved_offer_is_validated_before_any_decision_and_only_those_phases_carry_one: positive first (offer, skip->next serving the following key, done_hit, miss->next, BEGIN->first the oldest, END->done_none) then 4 decisions x 7 bad keys (unknown, ended, other sector, text, leading zero, signed, none) each refused with [roster.key] and nothing served, BEGIN/END/RESET with a key refused, roster unchanged and still served in order.
